recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Soup
recipes.description: Velvety, deeply tomatoey and ready for grilled cheese dunking.

steps.instruction: Soften the onion in olive oil over medium heat, then add the garlic for a minute.
Pour in the tomatoes and stock, season, and simmer for 20 minutes.
Blitz smooth, stir through the cream and torn basil, and serve.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.description: The real thing — eggs, cheese, guanciale and pasta water. No cream.

steps.instruction: Boil the spaghetti in well-salted water until al dente, reserving a mug of pasta water.
Crisp the guanciale slowly in a cold pan until the fat renders and it turns golden.
Whisk the egg yolks, whole egg, pecorino and lots of black pepper into a paste.
Toss the drained pasta with the guanciale off the heat, then stir in the egg mixture with splashes of pasta water until glossy.

recipes.title: Smash Burgers
recipes.description: Thin, lacy-edged patties with maximum crust. A griddle classic.

steps.instruction: Roll the beef into loose balls. Get a griddle screaming hot.
Smash each ball flat on the griddle, season hard, and don't touch for 2 minutes until a crust forms.
Flip, top with cheese and onions, and toast the buns alongside.
Stack with pickles and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.description: Slow-stirred, creamy and earthy. Meditative cooking.

steps.instruction: Brown the mushrooms in butter until golden, then set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic, add the rice and toast for a minute until translucent at the edges.
Deglaze with white wine, then add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring until each is absorbed.
Stir the mushrooms back in with the parmesan and a knob of butter to finish.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.description: Eggs poached in a spiced pepper and tomato sauce. Brunch hero.

steps.instruction: Soften the onion and peppers in oil, then add the garlic and spices.
Pour in the tomatoes and simmer until thick and jammy.
Make wells and crack in the eggs. Cover and cook until the whites set.
Crumble over feta and serve with bread.

recipes.title: Greek Salad
recipes.description: No lettuce. Just ripe tomatoes, cucumber, feta and good oil.

steps.instruction: Combine the tomatoes, cucumber and red onion in a wide bowl.
Top with a slab of feta and the olives.
Drizzle generously with olive oil and shower with oregano. Don't toss.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.description: Crisp edges, chewy middles, puddles of dark chocolate.

steps.instruction: Cream the butter with both sugars until pale and fluffy.
Beat in the eggs and vanilla, then fold in the flour and baking soda.
Fold through the chopped chocolate and chill the dough for 30 minutes.
Scoop onto trays, sprinkle with sea salt, and bake at 180°C for 11–13 minutes.

recipes.title: Fish Tacos
recipes.description: Crisp battered fish, quick slaw and a lime crema in soft tortillas.

steps.instruction: Whisk the flour and sparkling water into a loose batter.
Dip the fish strips and fry until crisp and golden, then drain.
Toss the cabbage with the juice of one lime for a quick slaw, and mix the soured cream with the rest.
Warm the tortillas, fill with fish, slaw and crema, and finish with coriander.

recipes.title: Thai Green Curry
recipes.description: Fragrant, coconut-rich and as hot as you dare to make it.

steps.instruction: Fry the curry paste in the thick top of the coconut milk until split and aromatic.
Add the chicken and seal, then pour in the rest of the coconut milk.
Add the aubergines, bamboo shoots and lime leaves, and simmer until tender.
Season with fish sauce and palm sugar, finish with thai basil.

recipes.title: Weeknight Chicken Stir-Fry
recipes.description: Fast, fresh and endlessly adaptable — on the table in 20 minutes.

steps.instruction: Heat the vegetable oil in a wok over high heat. Sear the chicken until golden and just cooked through, then remove.
Add the broccoli, peppers and carrot to the hot wok and stir-fry until crisp-tender.
Add the garlic and ginger, toss for 30 seconds, then return the chicken with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Finish with sliced spring onions and serve over rice.

recipes.title: Classic Beef Bolognese
recipes.description: A rich, slow-simmered ragù with beef and pork, built on a proper soffritto. Worth the time.

steps.instruction: Heat the olive oil and butter in a large, heavy pot over a medium-low heat. Add the finely chopped onion, carrot and celery along with a pinch of salt, and cook gently for 10–15 minutes until soft, sweet and translucent with no browning. Add the garlic and cook for a further 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then remove the soffritto and set aside, leaving the fat behind.
Raise the heat and brown the beef and pork mince in the same pot, breaking it up well. Take your time — a deep brown crust is where the flavour lives.
Return the soffritto to the pot. Pour in the red wine and let it bubble until almost fully reduced, scraping up the browned bits.
Stir in the chopped tomatoes, tomato paste, milk and bay leaves. Season, bring to a bare simmer, then cook uncovered on the lowest heat for 2–3 hours, stirring occasionally.
Taste and adjust the salt and pepper. Discard the bay leaves before serving over fresh pasta.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.description: Dense, moist and freckled with brown spots. Best the next day.

steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 175°C and line a loaf tin. Mash the bananas in a large bowl.
Whisk in the melted butter, sugar, eggs and vanilla.
Fold in the flour and baking soda until just combined, then the walnuts.
Pour into the tin and bake for 55–65 minutes until a skewer comes out clean.

cookHistory.notes: Extra sea salt on top next time
